title: Synergistic Fusion of Topological Structure and Temporal Semantics of Mobility for Urban Region Embedding
abstract: arXiv:2609.08268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Urban region embeddings have shown promising results in diverse urban sensing tasks such as crime, income, and service-call prediction. Recent methods improve representation quality by integrating mobility data with auxiliary modalities, using cross-view attention or contrastive objectives to align heterogeneous features into a unified region representation. However, leveraging the temporal dynamics of human mobility remains under-explored. Regional inflow and outflow fluctuate throughout the day, and inter-region connections emerge, persist, and dissolve over time. Moreover, prevailing fusion strategies combine views additively and miss the joint signal that emerges only when views co-occur. translated_title: 城市区域嵌入中移动性的拓扑结构与时间语义协同融合
translated_abstract: 城市区域嵌入在犯罪、收入和服务呼叫预测等多种城市感知任务中已展现出良好的效果。最近的方法通过将移动性数据与辅助模态相结合，利用跨视图注意力或对比学习目标将异构特征对齐为统一的区域表示，从而提升表示质量。然而，如何利用人类移动性的时间动态仍缺乏充分探索。区域的流入和流出在一天中不断波动，区域间的连接也随时间推移而出现、持续和消解。此外，主流的融合策略以相加的方式组合各视图，错失了仅在视图共同出现时才会涌现的联合信号。为解决这些不足，我们提出了移动性流-结构协同方法（MoSS），从移动性数据中提取互补的视图：一个保留每个区域每小时流入/流出概况的序列视图，以及一个基于之字形持续性的结构视图……
tldr: 提出MoSS方法，协同融合移动数据的时序语义（每小时流入/流出序列视图）与拓扑结构（结构视图），克服现有方法忽视时间动态以及加性融合丢失联合信号的缺陷，生成更优的城市区域嵌入。
en_tdlr: Proposes MoSS, which synergistically fuses the temporal semantics (an hourly inflow/outflow sequence view) and the topological structure of mobility data to produce better urban region embeddings, overcoming existing methods' neglect of temporal dynamics and the loss of joint signals in additive fusion.
